sources.snippet: Overview Mellum2-12B-A2.5B-Instruct is a Mixture-of-Experts instruction-tuned language model built by JetBrains that prioritizes direct, low-latency responses over explicit reasoning traces. The model uses a 64-expert architecture with 8 experts activated per token, 28 layers, 2304 hidden size, and supports a 131,072-token context window using sliding-window (1024) and full attention ...
